description: Set the orientation of the node-local system for all nodes in the range.

keywords.name: reverse-x
keywords.description: reverses the current \(x\) -direction (cannot be used with the \(x\) or \(y\) keywords)

keywords.name: reverse-y
keywords.description: reverses the current \(y\) -direction (cannot be used with the \(x\) or \(y\) keywords)

verification: 7.0: availability verified against official FLAC3D 7.0 contents command index (https://docs.itascacg.com/flac3d700/common/sel/doc/manual/sel_manual/nodes/commands/cmd_structure.node.system-local.html); syntax from official FLAC3D 7.0 detailed command page.
